tasks.title: Measurement invariants, capability reads and approved ports
tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then all reads. This is a fresh-session coder brief. Implement only owned_paths from E05 section 13; create no other files, shared types, configuration documents or replacement provider modules. Recheck the tree and docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating files. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, generated API contracts and the E21 demo fixture are absent; contracts/ and config/ contain only pharmacy artifacts. Do not touch those. E01/E02 are hard dependencies (SYSTEM 9). Start against published provider protocols and E01 kernel.testing (SYSTEM 10) once delivered, never invented signatures or permissive production fakes. R-E05-1 through R-E05-8 remain pending; proposals in a request are not interfaces. Before implementing an affected binding require coordinator-approved complete declarations, generated effective schemas and provider tests. Report missing inputs with the exact proposed change to the supervisor/coordinator; do not edit the design or requests. Safe disabled behavior is not completed acceptance.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput, ClockSegments and ClockCorrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity, Unit, WireQuantity and WireUnitConverter; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope mapping; 5.6 ReleaseHandle and snapshot-bound configuration; 5.7 UnitOfWork, ReadSnapshot, StorageSession, domain events, audiences and replication; 5.8 CommandIdentity, CommandPolicy, IdempotencyStore, CommandReceipts and ResultVisibility; 5.9 whole-envelope audit; 5.10 scheduler/tasks/evaluation isolation; 5.11 bounded HubSettings; 5.12 registration. Import exact declarations, no aliases from older provider designs. SYSTEM 6 defines uv --project hub, pnpm and generated contracts; 8.1/8.2/8.3/8.6 govern seams, eligibility, privacy and durability. Preserve D1/D3/D5/D6/D7/D12/D13/D17/D18 and Q8. No model, device or ground dependency on direct manual care or fixed help. No UI literals, domain defaults, sample fallback, safety mapping edit, speculative abstraction or own queue/clock/ledger.

Tests come first and trace to E05 section 1.1, sections 12/12.1 and the T-E05/R/V/D/invariants named below. Use configuration-derived explicit test inputs, independently checked clinical expectations, property tests for parsers/rules and zero/negative/empty/maximum/changed-unit cases. Unit/integration tests are hermetic. Real-stack acceptance uses production composition and real temporary SQLite; mocks inside the hub cannot pass it. Own tests stay in owned_paths. Done means all assigned behavior and gates pass without missing-test skips/xfails, approved prerequisites exist, and evidence names every trace and unresolved issue. A bug gets a failing test before its fix and the full hub suite afterwards. Final epic acceptance additionally needs T5, CI, independent build review (at most three rounds) and coordinator AI-USE-LOG.md entries. No git commands. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash.

Build E05 sections 3/3.1, read-side 4, 8/8.1 and 11: pure request/attempt/gap invariants, operational capability composition, bounded authorized queries and approved ports. Leave SQL/migrations to T2, commands/acquisition to T3, Vue to T4 and registration/router/end-to-end to T5. Supply the shared configuration-derived test setup in conftest.py; other tasks request additions from you instead of editing it. Freeze the local domain/repository seam with T2 before releasing it. Cross-epic ports wait for R-E05-1/5/7, generated models and E01 kernel.testing; pure invariant work can proceed once the kernel exists. No new validator may replace E27 kit checks or E01 observation policy.

Map generated Capability, MeasurementRequest and CapabilityGap exactly (docs/product/api/schemas/capability.schema.json:1, measurement-request.schema.json:1, capability-gap.schema.json:1). The request's nine states are proposed, awaiting_acceptance, accepted, in_progress, completed, unavailable, declined, cancelled, failed; attempt outcomes success/failed/rejected; gap open/addressed. Preserve nullable episode/operator/consent/body-region fields and the create-body omission versus null distinction for operator_id. I1 through I8 in E05 section 3 are executable invariants. Terminal late evidence changes history without reviving state. Review comment 1: every committed change of the request representation increments revision once, including an appended terminal attempt; exact replay/no-op never increments. T3 applies the rule transactionally; your model must support it. Same-request failed-attempt retry, unavailable action and late review remain disabled until R-E05-3, not new local enum values.

CapabilityQueries.get is a registry read and never invokes RequestGatePort (E05 section 2); prevent E11/E05 recursion. Use E27 KitCapability fields verbatim (docs/tdd/E27.md:165): code, label, body_region, operator_requirement, expected_duration_seconds, methods, instrument_ids, missing_instrument_ids, applicable_environments, kit_status, kit_reason. Consume KitCapabilitiesPort and InstrumentReadinessPort only with the approved caller snapshot/release binding of R-E05-1. SYSTEM 4.2 names KitGate; do not copy E27's conflicting KitGatePort alias. E11 owns RequestGatePort and its agreed CapabilityFact/RequestContext/GateResult. E23 owns MissionStatePort/OverlayPort; E28 owns GapPlanPort.plan_for. Import approved application ports only. Unknown environment, operator, policy or readiness never means available; disconnected but readable equipment has a separate configured manual method, broken/absent equipment does not. Never promote not_in_kit. Public listCapabilities has no patient parameter and exposes operational facts only. Personal request/gap reads use current object and leaf-field access; officer/help/task membership alone is insufficient. Until R-E05-4, no helper invitation or adapter projection is fabricated. Until R-E05-7, no new gap HTTP route or addressed transition.

Read kit-map.json through E27, indicator-catalog.json for display, ui-copy.json for words/templates, environment-profiles.json through E23, onboard-plans.json through E28 and effective unit-mapping.json through E01 (E05 section 8). E05 owns none of them. New work uses new release content; open work keeps its pins while actual current consent/device/environment is rechecked. Unknown plan provider gives null plan_id and empty alternatives/check_another_way_step_ids. A gap requires an episode and at most one gap per request; no episode means retained KitCheck and audited no_episode, not a synthetic episode. No substitute, normal value, import or forecast closes an instrument gap.

Write test_capabilities.py first: T-E05-01, T-E05-02, T-E05-09 for R07/R08, E05-01, V11/V17/V18/V19/V20/V28/V75/V78, D06/D12/D30 and I1/I7. Property-test all kit/readiness/context/operator/consent combinations with independently stated denial expectations and the approved gate precedence: access/binding, references, kit, context, operator, method/device, consent. Test registry batch/page bounds and schema enums/nulls. Change a scratch kit label and instrument membership, prove changed query results with no code edit, then reject corrupt/missing configuration retaining last good pin; no safety mapping changes. Test missing provider versus empty facts, no ground dependency, absent/incapacitated operator, current access revocation and current-versus-pinned facts after activation. Use declared port/kernel fakes here; T5 owns real E27/E15/E28 and HTTP evidence. T-E05-02 persistence and no-dispatch proofs belong to T2/T3/T5, not a fake-only claim. Storage faults from reads propagate. Done includes a typed handoff of approved ports and pure values, no placeholder shared DTOs and all owned gates.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/measurement/test_capabilities.py

uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/measurement/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/model.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/ports.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/queries.py hub/tests/measurement/conftest.py hub/tests/measurement/test_capabilities.py

uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/measurement/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/model.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/ports.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/queries.py hub/tests/measurement/conftest.py hub/tests/measurement/test_capabilities.py

uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/measurement/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/model.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/domain/errors.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/__init__.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/ports.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/queries.py hub/tests/measurement/conftest.py

e05_import_config=$(mktemp)
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output "$e05_import_config" && uv run --project hub lint-imports --config "$e05_import_config"

Store request home node, immutable creation release/source references, validated generated states, nullable wire fields, original clock/segment/capture revision and correction provenance, immutable attempts/results and disposition. E01 alone stores observations; use agreed record references through ports, never SQL against E01 or E15 tables. Canonical quantities, if persisted, are validated decimal text plus UCUM, never SQL REAL. Sequence allocation survives adapter restart, delayed unseen lower sequence remains append-only history, duplicate payload is a no-op and changed payload conflicts under the keyed identity supplied by SYSTEM 5.8. Each mutation declares its SYSTEM 5.7 ReplicationChange in the caller UOW, with explicit export_projection=None while R-E05-8 is unresolved; reference-only payload and registered local audience. No invented measurement export catalog/schema. T5 registers the accepted local projection; repository tests use E01's documented registration harness. Use shared fault injection facilities, not a custom persistence framework. Prove either no committed effects or all effects at every boundary and no acknowledgment before commit. Audit verification includes timestamps and sequences, using E01 AuditVerifier. Verify additive upgrade with the previous reader and software rollback preserving accepted rows; never drop tables to roll back. Restore heads and current authorization are E01/E02 responsibilities: test that an unresolved head cannot authorize old acquisition replay, without implementing restore locally. Real whole-command/physical-start crash tests are T3/T5 and rerun this suite.

Additional AGENTS 6 cases: original observed time and mission/origin survive clock changes/restart; concurrent cancellation cannot be undone by old attempts; large/outage backlogs use bounded pages and stable append order, not observation-time pagination; malformed/partial input and changed unit/device never partially persist; corrupted release references fail visibly. Configuration content behavior is proven by T1 and rerun during T5, no domain defaults in SQL. Done requires tests/gates, all six tables inside the shared UOW and no edits outside these four paths.

Build E05 sections 4/5 and command-side 3.1/8.1/9/10/11 using T1 values/ports and T2 repository. Leave HTTP/registration to T5, presentation to T4 and all devices, camera analysis, E01 validation/records, E11 eligibility, E27 kit calculation, E15 episodes and E30 guided checks to their owners. Require R-E05-1/2/3/4/5/6 for full workflow acceptance. No coder may freeze pending MeasurementAssignmentPort, AcquisitionBinding, MeasurementCommands or worker DTOs from a proposal. When those published interfaces arrive, import the provider protocols and use kernel fakes until real providers land. A pending seam blocks that feature, not direct E01 manual entry.

Implement createMeasurementRequest, actOnMeasurementRequest and recordAttempt use cases with SYSTEM 5.7/5.8. Authenticate/current operation access before receipt lookup, reauthorize replay object/fields, compare full identity before mutable preconditions and again under IMMEDIATE. Commit unavailable request, KitCheck, optional gap, audit, outbox, replication and receipt before returning KIT_CANNOT_PERFORM; raising inside the UOW must not undo the refusal. Approved controller MeasurementProposalPort/GapProposalPort effects join E13's apply UOW, never speculate or commit their own transaction. Use T1's approved gate precedence at proposal/submit/accept/start; no assistant may accept, start, create measured values, review late evidence or change warnings. No request with consent refusal becomes a clinical gap. No result before explicit operator acceptance and start. Reserve attempt/result capacity before physical capture (R-E05-6).

Settle cold-review comment 1 in commands.py: start, cancel, successful/failed/rejected attempt addition, terminal quarantined addition and any other representation change increment revision exactly once per committed change, with a matching transition, GET ETag and measurement_request.changed revision. Exact duplicate attempt/key replay changes nothing. Cold-review comment 2: within the producer UOW authorize EpisodeFacts.get/visible_to and bind subject/mission/origin; reject unknown/unauthorized episodes. A resolved episode is valid for new authorized work. Insert the request, publish the approved MeasurementRequestChanged, and let E15 link/reopen as new_activity in that same UOW (docs/tdd/E15.md:265,509,1071). Commit request/link/reopening/audit/receipt together; rollback all on consumer failure. No prerequisite external reopen command, own E15 SQL or eventual-outbox claim of atomic reopening. R-E05-1 must supply the exact internal payload before this binding starts.

Start submits TaskInput with public_kind=None to SYSTEM 5.10.1 in the start UOW. Worker execute occurs outside any writer transaction, apply only inside generation-checked completion; recovery.py registers through T5 rather than inventing a queue. R-E05-2's approved persisted assignment binds request revision, acquisition/generation, adapter/device/method, subject/operator, mission/origin, release and action consent. Trusted producer proof includes sample/time/quality provenance, never context or quality_notes as authority. Cancellation commits logical state and fences generation before bounded physical stop; cannot_stop/unknown remain visible. Receipt reconciliation cannot blind-restart a physical acquisition. Cancelled TaskRunner completion cannot make a usable result, and discard cannot erase real late evidence: the authenticated producer retains it until recordAttempt commits quarantine. E01 appends validated observations in the same attempt UOW; E01 recordObservation with measurement_request_id calls the approved validate_record_link/link_record in its own outer UOW. E05 never mounts that route. Direct unlinked self/verified-officer manual capture has no E05 assignment dependency.

Cold-review comment 3: E30 exists. Its ReferenceWindowRequest is keyed by guided_check_id/attempt_no/record_id/window and CameraReferencePort.begin_window/outcome/abandon, not a MeasurementRequest (docs/tdd/E30.md:448). Do not synthesize a request ID or treat guided-check acceptance as E05 acceptance. PLAN Requests specifies the coordinator binding required for R-E05-2: preserve that independent guided lifecycle and E01 manual append; bridge to a measurement only with a persisted authorized relationship and explicit E05 acceptance. No import of E30 Clock.read, ConfigReader.snapshot, UnitConverter or legacy RecordsWriter in place of SYSTEM APIs. Its discard-on-abandon wording cannot erase real clinical late evidence. Keep incompatible integration off pending owner agreement. Camera absence must never veto the valid manual count.

Write test_workflow.py first for T-E05-03, T-E05-04, T-E05-05, T-E05-15 (R06/R07/R08, V05/V08/V09/V11/V13/V23/V25/V34, D06/D08/D11/D30, I1/I2/I3/I5/I6/I8): property-test transitions and actor/subject/adapter/device/generation/origin combinations; terminal duplicate and concurrent If-Match cases; logical/physical cancel races and late review; forbidden assistant effects and stale/cancelled E13 rollback. Test comment 2 from resolved and unauthorized episodes; use provider protocols in unit tests, require real integration in T5. Test every command write/commit/dispatch receipt crash point, disk full and response loss; no duplicate physical start. Storage/I/O/integrity/configuration/authorization/validation exceptions abort; only EvaluatorComputationFailure is isolated through E01 EvaluationIsolation with pinned durable pending work (D13).

Write test_records.py first for T-E05-06, T-E05-07, T-E05-14 (R06/E05-03, V07/V14/V15/V85/V86/V87, D09/D11/D12, I4/I7/I8): finite Quantity and sourced unit/method checks, zero versus missing, partial pulse without breathing, empty successful outcome refusal, supersession, conflict retention and no averaging. Preserve original observed/entered/received times; same raw instant in two segments stays distinct, unknown time never current, late sequences never overwrite newer state, elapsed acquisition timeout shifts under correction but absolute consent expiry does not. Activation during capture preserves pins and warnings. Comment 4 explicitly adds camera NO_READING: retain the manual count with provenance through E01, E30 shows unchecked, and E12/E13 cannot use it as support. Counterparts T30-04, T30-05, T30-09, T-E12-022 and T-E13-041, T-E13-042 plus T5's real integration must pass. Also agree/disagree cases, retry history, no ECG-gap closure, diagnosis or success award on disagreement, no clinical drill writes. Imported values require E09 confirmed original source/date. Missing providers or pending late-review contract cannot be passed by tests of the interim alone. Done is all assigned gates and a reviewed binding handoff to T5; request declaration changes from their owners, never locally extend wire shapes.

uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/commands.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/application/recovery.py hub/src/crew_health/measurement/adapters/acquisition.py hub/tests/measurement/test_workflow.py hub/tests/measurement/test_records.py
